guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster / Gibson Les Paul / PRS
guitar.notes: Rik Emmett is moderately well known guitarist who used a mix of Strat/Les Paul/PRS over Triumph's career; no single overwhelmingly iconic model.

tone.target: bright 80s arena crunch with upper-mid bite
tone.profile: bright 80s arena crunch with upper-mid bite
tone.summary: A compressed signal chain utilizing a Boost/OD pedal into the UK 45 or UK 50 amp model, paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cab. Chorus adds necessary 80s sheen, while EQ boosts upper-mids for bite and punch.

rig.name: Triumph - Lay It On The Line - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and background noise.
blocks.gap: None. Standard practice for high-gain rock tones.

blocks.purpose: Provide tight, controlled boost for lead lines and punchy rhythm playing.
blocks.gap: None. Boost is ideal for adding focused drive without excessive fuzz.

alternatives.reason: Good alternative, but 'Boost' offers a tighter, more controlled punch suitable for the specified 'tight palm-mute'.

blocks.purpose: Add stacked rock crunch and grit without entering fuzzy territory.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style is chosen for its aggressive, tight mid-range bite, mimicking the punch of 80s arena rock. A dedicated Plexi model would be ideal but is not available.

alternatives.reason: More general distortion; RAT offers more focused upper-mid aggression.

blocks.purpose: Add the necessary 80s arena sheen and width to lead lines.
blocks.gap: None. Chorus is essential for achieving the '80s arena' sound.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the bright, punchy sound of a Marshall Plexi/British amp head.
blocks.gap: None. The UK 45 is the best model for classic British rock tones.

alternatives.reason: Also excellent, but the UK 45 often provides a slightly brighter, more aggressive bite suitable for this specific 'upper-mid bite' requirement.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British rock cabinet tone and necessary upper-mid punch.
Boost the upper-mids and high frequencies to achieve maximum bite and clarity.
blocks.gap: None. Targeted EQ boost is crucial for achieving 'upper-mid bite'.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle depth and space without muddying the tight rhythm tone.
blocks.gap: A short, clean delay adds necessary 'arena sheen' without distracting from the core crunch.

alternatives.reason: Too warm and vintage; Digital Delay provides a cleaner, more modern 80s echo.

blocks.purpose: Provide a subtle sense of space and 'arena' scale.
blocks.gap: None. Room reverb is versatile for rock settings.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet IR to enhance upper-mid clarity and vintage British rock character.

proposals.recommendedAsset: vintage 4x12 UK IR (e.g., Celestion Greenback/V30 style)
proposals.reason: Enhance upper-mid bite and vintage British rock character beyond the default 'UK Vintage 4x12'.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and punch in the high end.
